command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; ST=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo pre_call_state=$ST; test "$ST" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/tmp/phase2-install.log; cat /tmp/phase2-install.log; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); test -n "$APK"; echo '=== construct 16k ==='; OUT16=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.CallAssistantAudioProbe construct 16000"); printf '%s
' "$OUT16"; printf '%s
' "$OUT16" | grep -q 'backend=SamsungCallAssistantTrack'; printf '%s
' "$OUT16" | grep -q 'construction=success'; echo '=== construct 48k ==='; OUT48=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.CallAssistantAudioProbe construct 48000"); printf '%s
' "$OUT48"; printf '%s
' "$OUT48" | grep -q 'backend=SamsungCallAssistantTrack'; printf '%s
' "$OUT48" | grep -q 'construction=success'; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1)" = "0"; rm -f /tmp/phase2-install.log; echo phase2_shared_backend_runtime_ok=true
